terms.comment: By modern extension of a medieval trencher or carving board: Morgan–Owens traces incīsōrium to medieval dining and carving use. The modern chopping-board sense is an extension.

phrases.english: Cut the apple on the cutting board.

phrases.latin: Hoc est incīsōrium; haec est rādula.
phrases.english: This is the cutting board; this is the grater.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
